scope: Clear, accessible recovery for stale desktop links, failed pages and unavailable page modules without losing healthy component state during query navigation.
qualification: Local Linux acceptance. Real sandbox/Temporal/NSR and signed platform release gates remain pending.

baseline_failures: Packaged dashboard recovery linked to filesystem root instead of the hash route.
A mounted route boundary retained its error after navigation.
A rejected lazy module offered a boundary retry although React.lazy caches the rejection.
observed_regressions.reproduction_limit: The frozen navigation reproduction changes pathname in an isolated boundary. The final regression changes chat query on the same pathname, because the real Layout already remounts content on pathname changes.

fixture_isolation.initial_result: Lint, both builds and all 2,650 unit tests passed, then the invalid-workspace fixture observed two GET / requests on its local server and failed. Native checks were not reached.
fixture_isolation.cause_assessment: Those requests do not match any harness API path. Another local process probing the open port is a plausible explanation, not proven attribution.
fixture_isolation.change: Run the invalid-configuration child with a preloaded fetch prohibition and no local server. The existing configuration error must occur before any fetch attempt; timeout, failure and credential-redaction assertions remain.

implementation: Use router-aware replacement links for recovery within browser and packaged-file routing.
Show a minimal, theme-aware Page not found screen with dashboard and chat destinations; preserve the workspace and require sign-in before workspace recovery.
Clear only failed content on route-key, path, query or hash changes; retain healthy drafts and component state.
Offer reload for rejected page modules and ordinary retry for render errors; normalize non-Error throws and keep bounded technical details collapsed.
Announce loading, name pages, focus recovery headings and recovered content, and use theme tokens for readable status text.
Return top-level recovery outside the router to the browser dashboard path or original packaged renderer file.

verification.unit_lint_and_build_scope: Passed phases of the initial run; application inputs unchanged. Only fixture isolation changed for the successful remaining run.
verification.new_native_cases: Browser dark/light and packaged-file light recovery verify focus, title, WCAG checks, both destinations and a retained window-document marker.
verification.visual_review: Inspected all three recovery screenshots: readable theme colors, consistent spacing, visible destinations and intact workspace navigation.

source_guard.method: Manual SHA256 of all tracked and new input files before and after verification; not an immutable Buildr snapshot.

limitations: Three opt-in live checks remain skipped without staging configuration. Owned API fixtures do not prove real sandbox, Temporal or NSR acceptance.
The packaged-file routing fixture uses E2E mode and a mocked isPackaged value. Separate production Linux startup/restart runs without E2E mode; signed macOS/Windows qualification remains pending.
Dependencies, package version, visual references and snapshot tolerances are unchanged. Existing advisory findings remain documented in desktop-security-2026-10-15.json.
Changes are for the existing review branch; no release publication, tag movement or merge.
